label: Python migration drift (Alembic)
description: Alembic upgrades the run's own services database to head and checks that the models need no new migration (alembic check). Comes in by evidence: alembic.ini; runs only where migration is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
